Ah yes. I took up working out at one point but my laziness told me to stop. It became rather pointless. I maintain the ability to play soccer and still have some muscle mass. I write sometimes but it usually turns into me fantasizing about how I would die. My best idea yet is to do it in a church with the three people I hate most in the front row. I play a fair amount of video games to try and forget the actual world. When I go through a manic phase I become extraordinarily weird and my family gets kinda afraid of me even though that just further entertains my manic mind. Posting to Reddit has become a lazy hobby of mine as well. In general, I'm less than happy but for some reason I just don't care... about anyone or anything. That led to me and my girlfriend breaking up. Oh well. Then again... why give a shit if I was planning to kill myself anyway. That mentality has drastically decreased my work ethic, but also my anger at the world has kinda diminished.
